description: Source code for MojoVideoEncodeAcceleratorService class, which manages video encoding acceleration via Mojo IPC in Chromium, including initialization, encoding, buffer management, and error handling.

classes.name: MojoVideoEncodeAcceleratorService
classes.description: A service class managing video encoding acceleration via Mojo IPC, handling initialization, encoding, buffer management, and error reporting.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and binds a self-owned Mojo receiver for the VideoEncodeAccelerator interface.

methods.name: MojoVideoEncodeAcceleratorService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with callback and GPU preferences.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with configuration, client, media log, and success callback.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a video frame, with optional keyframe forcing.

methods.name: UseOutputBitstreamBuffer
methods.description: Provides an output buffer for encoded bitstream.

methods.name: RequestEncodingParametersChangeWithLayers
methods.description: Requests change in encoding parameters with layer info.

methods.name: RequestEncodingParametersChangeWithBitrate
methods.description: Requests change in encoding parameters with specific bitrate.

methods.name: IsFlushSupported
methods.description: Checks if flush operation is supported.

methods.name: RequireBitstreamBuffers
methods.description: Sets required bitstream buffers and notifies client.

methods.name: BitstreamBufferReady
methods.description: Notifies that a bitstream buffer is ready with metadata.

methods.name: NotifyErrorStatus
methods.description: Reports an error status to the client.

methods.name: NotifyEncoderInfoChange
methods.description: Notifies client of encoder info change.
